requirements: Keep the existing unified product Shell as the only Shell.

queryParameters.resource: Required resource URL when the S001 default is not used.
queryParameters.scenarioId: Host scenario identity retained in deep links.
queryParameters.returnFrom: Optional module id used for the return receipt.

operations.sync-breadcrumb: Update the host breadcrumb without changing route.
operations.navigate-parent-module: Route to the requested canonical module and retain returnUrl.
operations.open-m08: Adapt context to M08 and route to moduleId=modeling / #module/modeling.

hostAdapterRequirements: Accept the message only from the mounted M07 iframe and same origin.
Pass message.context as the immutable M08 input context.
Forward OFW_M07_OPEN_M08 with payload=message.context to the modeling mount without renaming the message.
Persist returnUrl outside M07 and restore it when M08 returns.
Do not rename M07 to exploration or share M08 state with the M07 resource.
m08Handoff.missingSeriesBehavior: M08 must show an unavailable-input state when seriesRef is null; it must not invent a series.
